fact: Daz spots papers on Eldgrim's desk.
source_quote: He had already spotted papers on Eldgrim's desk
subject: Daz

fact: Daz flatters Eldgrim by proposing to write a book about the Empty-Scabbard Killers to lure him to his desk.
source_quote: Flattering Eldgrim with talk of writing a book and immortalizing the fame of the Empty-Scabbard Killers, he persuaded the assassin leader to walk over to his desk
subject: Daz

fact: Eldgrim signs a piece of parchment for Daz.
source_quote: persuaded the assassin leader to walk over to his desk and sign his name on a piece parchment
subject: Eldgrim

fact: Eldgrim is flattered by Daz's offer to write a book about his group.
source_quote: Eldgrim was "actually kind of flattered."
subject: Eldgrim

fact: Thorin questions the logic of the Empty-Scabbard Killers' name to create a distraction.
source_quote: Thorin — genuinely baffled by the logic of a group of killers who carried empty scabbards — blurted out his confusion aloud
subject: Thorin

fact: A soulblade manifests a shimmering psionic weapon in response to Thorin's question.
source_quote: prompting one of the soulblades to manifest a shimmering psionic weapon in wordless explanation
subject: soulblade psionic manifestation

fact: Daz steals a document bearing the royal seal of Gracklstugh and the Deepking's signature from Eldgrim's desk.
source_quote: he slipped away a document bearing the royal seal of Gracklstugh and the signature of the Deepking himself
subject: document theft

fact: The stolen document proves the crown is secretly in league with the Empty-Scabbard Killers.
source_quote: proof that the crown was secretly in league with the assassins
subject: royal contract

fact: Eldgrim has a low passive perception score.
source_quote: Aided by Eldgrim's "awful" passive perception
subject: Eldgrim

fact: The DM warns that the assassins will not discover the theft immediately, describing the urgency as a clock rather than an immediate consequence.
source_quote: the DM warned that "there's a clock," though the assassins would not work it out "like tomorrow."
subject: assassins' timeline

fact: Daz fakes a violent coughing fit to create a distraction.
source_quote: Daz staged a violent coughing fit
subject: Daz

fact: Zalthir breathes fire onto Eldgrim's desk at Daz's cue.
source_quote: when Zalthir came over to help him he thumped the dragonborn hard in the chest — Zalthir's cue to breathe a gout of fire directly onto the desk
subject: Zalthir

fact: The remaining papers on Eldgrim's desk are burned by Zalthir's fire.
source_quote: The remaining papers went up in flames.
subject: evidence destruction

fact: Eldgrim banishes the party from the Empty-Scabbard Killers' territory under threat of death.
source_quote: Eldgrim erupted in fury, cursing the party and ordering them out of his territory under threat of death
subject: Eldgrim's banishment

fact: Eldgrim threatens that the Empty-Scabbard Killers will kill the party if they return.
source_quote: warning that if they ever returned, the Empty-Scabbard Killers would deal with them the way they should have from the start
subject: Eldgrim

fact: The party exits the lair and arrives at an intersection near the obelisk chamber entrances.
source_quote: The party exits the lair, passing by invisible guards, and arrives at an intersection near the main and side entrances of the obelisk chamber.
subject: party exit

fact: Two invisible guards fist-bump the party as they leave the lair.
source_quote: The invisible soulblades fist-bump the party on the way out.
subject: invisible guards

fact: Daz says goodbye to the invisible soulblades, promising to return soon.
source_quote: Daz, to two more soulblades: "Thanks. It was great doing business with you guys. We'll be back soon. Hopefully with. Or not."
subject: Daz

fact: Thorin proposes "Plausible deniability" as the group's name.
source_quote: Thorin proposes "Plausible deniability" as the group's long-needed name
subject: Thorin

fact: The Empty-Scabbard Killers are led by Eldgrim.
source_quote: Eldgrim, the boss of the Empty-Scabbard Killers
subject: Empty-Scabbard Killers

fact: The DM declares the Werz objective complete if the party deals with the Demogorgon cultists.
source_quote: Assuming the party deals with the Demogorgon cultists, the DM declares the Werz objective done
subject: Werz objective
